meta.move: Secret: evidence lands on the late night
meta.expect: After the times, she goes shorter and harder, to procedure (who decided, 4.2); does not ask about that night again; no laptop; debrief says how close it came

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with who decided on the zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong, and I own it.
Okay. And Owen found out from the gradebook, on his phone, in the middle of class. What do you have that says he didn't write it?

Here's the version history. The document was created Wednesday October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58 PM another 794. Then small edits. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing down the times. Procedure 4.2 says you call me before any mark is entered, and nobody did. Who else has seen this?
So he wrote nothing until almost midnight the night before it was due, and then fourteen hundred words appeared in six minutes.
That's your reading of it, Hale. A version history shows when text arrived in a document, not who wrote it or where it was written first. And you still entered a zero on it before anyone called me.
What was he doing at midnight that night?
I'm not the one being questioned, Hale. You're the one who entered a zero without calling me. Procedure 4.4 is on the table, so tell me what you're proposing.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology and a written promise that nothing goes on Owen's record; that is not yet the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite under 4.4, because you never put it forward, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before you called her, in a sentence, without defending it, and that earned a flat okay and took the procedure fight off the table for a moment.
What cost ground: You asked what Owen was doing at midnight, which asked her for testimony she was never going to give, so it brought you nothing new and let her turn back to your own procedure.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its late-night times of 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58 PM, and then your question about midnight, came very close to that night, and that is why she went shorter and harder, but it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After showing the version history, put the 4.4 supervised rewrite on the table yourself, private and in writing with nothing on his record, instead of asking about midnight.
